samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Detects pulses in a 1-bit input signal data_in. A pulse is defined as a sequence of 010. The output signal data_out indicates the end of a pulse.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter name="RISING">Rising edge detected.</parameter>
        <parameter name="FALLING">Falling edge detected.</parameter>
        <parameter name="PULSE_END">End of pulse detected.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="state" type="reg" width="2">State register.</register>
        <wire id="next_state" type="wire" width="2">Next state wire.</wire>
        <wire id="data_out_reg" type="wire">Data out register.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= IDLE;
                data_out_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                            next_state = RISING;
                        end else begin
                            next_state = IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                    RISING: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                            next_state = FALLING;
                        end else begin
                            next_state = IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                    FALLING: begin
                        if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                            next_state = PULSE_END;
                        end else begin
                            next_state = IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                    PULSE_END: begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                endcase
                state <= next_state;
                if (state == PULSE_END) begin
                    data_out_reg <= 1;
                end else begin
                    data_out_reg <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
        assign data_out = data_out_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
